l5_ecog3_meaning.quote: Standard second-line and later options are built for ECOG 0 to 2: CAR-T re-treatment is not an option, transplant is out, and the bispecific antibodies (glofitamab, epcoritamab) and most trials require ECOG 0 to 2.

l5_capacity.quote: Capacity is intact: he is alert, follows and repeats the conversation accurately, and asks appropriate questions, so his refusal stands.

l5_respect_refusal_goc.quote: Respect his informed refusal and change the plan to comfort-focused care, while keeping the door open.

l5_hospice_palliative.quote: home hospice is the option that matches his stated wish to be at home. Hospice does not end palliative radiotherapy or symptom treatment

l5_advance_directive.quote: Code status: discuss DNR and DNI, complete a MOLST or POLST form, and name a health-care proxy (confirm whether that is his wife).

l5_financial_social_work.quote: Refer urgently to oncology social work and a financial counselor at the cancer center.

l5_caregiver_support.quote: ask for a hospice social worker and home aide visits, and arrange respite care so his wife is not the only caregiver.

l5_mn_pressure_treatment.quote: Respect his informed refusal and change the plan to comfort-focused care, while keeping the door open.

l5_mn_abandon.quote: Hospice does not end palliative radiotherapy or symptom treatment, and he can revoke it at any time.
